subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should experimental `claws remove` land with the proposed retained partial provenance but no permanent redacted removal tombstone, or must the lifecycle preserve a durable post-removal audit/recovery record first?
rationale: The patch implements a coherent technical path, but the PR discussion leaves the permanence and operator-recovery contract as an intentional product-policy choice that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Confirm the proposed experimental contract
options.body: Accept retained partial provenance for failure/status recovery and defer a permanent tombstone to a later explicitly scoped lifecycle design.

options.title: Require durable removal provenance
options.body: Keep this PR open until it records a narrow redacted tombstone or equivalent durable audit contract with retention and privacy rules.

recommendation.title: Confirm the proposed experimental contract
recommendation.body: Accept retained partial provenance for failure/status recovery and defer a permanent tombstone to a later explicitly scoped lifecycle design.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment frames the unresolved operator-facing inventory, recovery, and tombstone policy.
